proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Take the pair W' inside W inside U of the finite-flat-over-almost-dense lemma; the addendum gives u_j in W and that W' to W is a thickening of finite presentation. By the affines-glued-in-closed-affine lemma it suffices to find an R-invariant affine open V' of W' containing the orbit points, because the corresponding open V of W will be affine; hence replace the groupoid by its restriction to W', where s and t are finite locally free. By the properties maximal-points lemma one finds an affine open containing the union of the orbits of u_1, ..., u_m, and the groupoids find-invariant-affine lemma concludes. (source lines 2815-2833)
